description:
Saves the traffic statistics settings; send only what changes. Fields set by environment variables are ignored. Switching traffic_enabled changes the nginx access log; if that fails nothing is saved. delete_stats removes the stored statistics and is refused with 400 unless the same request switches traffic_enabled from true to false.
Needs: an administrator (a token needs its Administrator switch)

traffic_enabled.description: Whether traffic statistics are on, which writes the nginx access log. Default: off

retention_days.description: Days the hourly statistics are kept

show_ips.description: Store and show client IP addresses

unique_visitors.description: Count unique visitors with keyed IP hashes; turning it off deletes them

visitors_cap.description: Distinct visitors counted per host and day; beyond it new visitors are not counted and the day is marked as capped

delete_stats.description: Whether to delete all stored statistics (counts, top lists, IPs, visitor hashes) with this save. Only allowed together with traffic_enabled going from true to false

200.description: The traffic statistics settings as they are now
